objections.quote: Is it twenty-two carat? Does it have the hallmark?

coaching_tip: When she asked at 01:17 whether the making charge was included, show her the split of gold, making and GST. Once she said she'd take the sixteen-gram chain, suggest a light pendant or studs to wear with it every day.
flags: purity question at 00:39 recorded as purity_trust objection; answered with hallmark and HUID at 00:43
making-charge question at 01:17 treated as a clarification, not an objection
making percentage never quoted; only the total was given

customer.intent_evidence: 00:07 asked for daily-wear chains between fifteen and thirty grams

key_moments.what: showed three chains all within the asked 15-30 g range
confirmed 22 carat, hallmark and HUID on the clasp
quoted a full total including making and GST
liked the fit and chose the 16 g chain

missed_opportunities.what: no breakup of gold, making and GST when asked about making
no add-on such as a pendant suggested after the purchase

price_talk.notes: total including making and GST quoted at 01:10
